stage1.impression: A warm, deep, convincingly low-key room with a strong vanishing line: fir ceiling, record wall, counter and banquette lead to a lit altar, and the floating multicolour globe with its coloured shadow on the concrete makes it a specific place a magazine could name, not a generic bar. It still reads as a good CG render rather than a photograph: the Orb lamps are flat white discs, the counter top and floor go milky and marble-like, the identical tables, orbs and stools repeat in a row, the globe's thin glowing rims read slightly like neon tubing, and the wall's coloured caustic is the brightest large surface in the frame, so it pulls the eye away from the products.

blocking_9: Orb table lamps read as tinted smoked acrylic with a glowing frosted liner, not as uniform white discs (region 785-850 x 565-625 lum_median below 160, with visible tint and gradient)
Mother EARF's rims read as polished thick acrylic edges catching light, with the slotted discs' faces visible as tinted glass, rather than thin self-lit neon lines
The coloured shadow on the concrete wall sits below the globe and the altar in brightness, so the products stay the hero
Zinc counter top and honed concrete floor show real material (zinc patina, concrete pores, aggregate) instead of milky white or marble-like patches
The altar pair reads at a glance at the end of the room (lum_median 60 or more on both speakers) as smoked acrylic cabinets, not grey boxes
Banquette and right-hand foreground hold shadow detail (not a near-black mass) with leather or mohair texture visible
Less repetition: the row of identical tables, Orbs and stools broken up by props, turned seats and varied lamp states
Signs of life in the foreground: a glass or coat close enough to the lens to read as photographed

defects.what: Front Orb lamp reads as a flat white disc (median 196); no smoked tint, no liner depth, looks like a white ping-pong ball
Four identical tables, Orbs and rocks glasses in a perfectly repeating column: reads as copies of one model
Mother EARF: the rims read as thin emissive neon tubes; the cast-acrylic disc faces are barely visible, so the 25 mm thickness and polish don't come across
Coloured shadow on the wall is the brightest large surface in the frame (median 127, p95 167), brighter than the globe or the altar, and looks like a stained-glass projection
Counter top goes milky white-grey (median 134, p95 235) and reads as marble or laminate, not zinc
Floor patches read as marble veining or a tiled texture rather than honed concrete; it is brighter than the walls (median 65)
Banquette is a near-black mass (median 17.5, p5 2.4); upholstery channels barely legible
Altar speakers read as grey or white boxes with white drivers in black niches; the smoked tint and the light through the acrylic are lost at this distance
Ceiling boards and beams are smeared by the denoiser; the grain is soft and orange-cast (r 75, b 17), with no checks or nail holes
Framed screen images are flat grey rectangles with dark blobs; they read as placeholders
Back-bar niche speaker is washed grey and fogged; it reads as a flat poster

changes.problem: The coloured shadow on the concrete is the brightest large surface in the frame and competes with the globe and the altar.

evidence.measured: lum_median 127, p95 167, against the globe's region median 24 and the altar speakers' 44-68

changes.expected: The coloured shadow stays as a soft echo of the globe at about two thirds of its present brightness, and the eye goes to the globe and down the room.

changes.problem: The Orb lamps read as flat white discs with no smoked tint and no depth to the liner.
changes.expected: The Orbs drop to a warm glow behind the smoked shell, with a visible gradient from liner to rim and a pool of light on each table top.

changes.problem: The altar pair, the room's reason to exist, is under-lit at the end of the room and reads as grey boxes.

evidence.measured: left speaker lum_median 68; right speaker [660,360,695,430] lum_median 44, so the two are unequal

change.to: 160 W, cone 24 deg, aimed so both cabinets are lit equally

changes.expected: Both altar speakers lift to median 60-90 with their smoked acrylic and horns legible, and a clear pool of light on the altar.

changes.problem: The zinc counter top goes milky white and reads as marble or laminate.

change.to: darker aged zinc: base value lowered ~35 %, roughness 0.35-0.5 with mottled patina, faint rings and wipe marks

changes.expected: The counter reads as a dark blue-grey metal with specular streaks from the Dome downlights, not a pale slab.

changes.problem: The floor reads as patchy marble or tile and sits brighter than the walls.

evidence.measured: lum_median 65, p95 164; the y profile peaks at 83 mid-floor; veined mottle visible at 1:1

change.setting: the concrete: floor mottle and sealer
change.to: floor tone 20 % darker, mottle at a finer scale (aggregate and pores, no long veins), roughness 0.55-0.7

changes.expected: A darker honed concrete floor that holds the pools from the tables, with fine grain and no marble veining.

changes.problem: The banquette and right foreground are a near-black mass with no upholstery detail.

change.setting: the screens' images emission (fill on the banquette) and the frosted acrylic's roughness
change.to: 0.06, frosted roughness up a step so the screens throw a soft even fill on the seat backs

changes.expected: The banquette channels and seat cushions read in soft fill, median about 25-35, with the darkest areas still deep.

changes.problem: The tables, Orbs and glasses down the banquette repeat identically and read as copies of one model.

evidence.measured: four identical tables, lamps and rocks glasses aligned on one line

change.from: one rocks glass per table, in the same place
change.to: vary per table: a coupe and napkin on one, a menu and two glasses on another, one table empty and wiped, one with a record sleeve; the nearest table's glass half full with a lemon twist; turn each Orb 10-30 deg

changes.expected: The row reads as tables in use by different people; no two table tops match.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's rims read as thin neon tubes and its cast-acrylic disc faces disappear.

evidence.measured: region lum_median 24, but the rims are saturated self-lit lines; the disc faces barely separate from the ceiling

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, plus a 2nd low grazing light
change.to: rim glow 0.006, and a small warm spot (about 15 W, 2700 K, 10 deg) from the ceiling grazing the disc faces so they catch reflections

changes.expected: The globe reads as thick polished tinted acrylic catching real light (edges lit by light piped through the slab, faces with reflections), not as glow sticks; the colours stay as the owner chose.

out_of_scope.request: Thicker or less saturated rims on Mother EARF, or fewer colours
out_of_scope.why: The globe's shape and its six tints are EARF's product and the owner's choice; only its light is adjustable.

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar and back-bar speakers read as smoked rather than grey/white (the white batts show through)
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' tint and parts are fixed; only their lighting can help (c3).

out_of_scope.request: Replace the framed screens' images, which read as placeholders
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the screens and what they show.

out_of_scope.request: Break up the identical stools along the counter with different models
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the room's fixed design; the turns and offsets already allowed should go further within the 7 deg / 2.5 cm limits.

out_of_scope.request: Ceiling boards: reduce denoiser smear and add checks and nail holes
out_of_scope.why: Partly a render-quality issue (raise samples on the delivered 2400 x 1600 frame, lower denoise strength) rather than a setting on the card; flagged so it is not missed.
